title.narrative: The Global Fund Supported Project on HIV/AIDS in Viet Nam - Viet Nam (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Viet Nam, HIV, Vietnam Administration of Disease Prevention (VADP)This program has the following goals: Contribute to implementing the Vietnam National HIV/AIDS contro, reduce the number of the new HIV infections below 1000 cases/year, reduce annual mortality rate due to HIV/AIDS to below 1 death/100,000 people and end AIDS as a threat to public health in Vietnam by 2030; Reduce to a minimum the effects of the HIV/AIDS epidemic on socio-economic development.. Combining good practices and rational innovations to ensure effective participation by social and community-based organizations in significant HIV new infection reduction and sufficient health services delivery among key populations, thus contributing to successful implementation of the National Strategy on Ending AIDS by 2030. To strengthen the participation of social and community-based organizations to contribute to achieving objectives of the National Strategy to End the AIDS Epidemic by 2030.. The objectives of this program are: Expand and reform HIV prevention interventions, contribute to increasing access to HIV prevention services to 70% of the population whose behavior puts them at risk of HIV infection by 2025 and 80% by 2030. Expand coverage and diversify HIV testing and couselling modalities, promote conmunity-base HIV testing, self-testing and index testing, contribute to the goal of increasing the proportion of PLHIV who know their status to 90% by 2025 and 95% by 2030. Increase coverage and improve quality of HIV/AIDS treatment, contribute to the goal of 90% of people with diagnosed HIV infection receiving antiretroviral therapy by 2025 and 95% by 2030 and the goal of 95% of people receiving antiretroviral therapy achieving viral suppression every year. Consolidate and strengthen the capacity of the HIV/AIDS prevention and control system to closely surveil the HIV/AIDS epidemic situation in population groups whose behavior puts them at high risk of HIV. Provide innovative and effective community-based interventions in 15 provinces/cities of the project to significantly reduce HIV new infections and eliminate HIV transmission among key popolations, including MSM, TGW, PWID and FSW. Consolidate and strengthen community systems for sustainable and flexible HIV/AIDS response. Promote legal and policy framework and implemetation for fair and convenient access to health services. Provide community HIV prevention services for key populations in 17 provinces/cities. Strengthen community systems for eficient, resilient and stainable HIV/AIDS responses.. Improve access to health services for key populations.
